notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in your graveyard that has legal targets and that can be cast using {B}{B}.
easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast the other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the instant or sorcery.
Repeat.
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.
